messages.subject: pcountOpen
parts:
Hi All,

I'm having a problem fitting models using pcountOpen. I have
abundance data collected at the same sites for 2 years, so it seems
that an open model is appropriate, but I have only 1 secondary period
during the first year and 2 secondary periods during the second year.
I have added a column to the first year filled with "NA" values to
create a 4 column matrix: 2 columns for primary period 1 and 2 for
primary period 2. However, when I try to fit a model, I get a Runtime
Error, and R crashes. Right now I'm trying a null model (fm1 <-
pcountOpen(~1, ~1, ~1, ~1, gs.umf)), but I've tried to parameterize it
and that doesn't work either. Is my data too sparse to run this type
of model? I've pasted the summary of the unmarkedFramePCO below. I
appreciate any suggestions anyone has to offer!

Lucretia
